title: Have you experienced the slippery/slidey floors in your mall?
content: Almost every time I been in the mall, the floors are super slippery and it's really easy to glide around them on my feet like skating and gain tremendous speed. I always feel in control when sliding around and sometimes drop to my knees and coast into a shop. I often wonder why that's such a persistent feature of my malls. It's really good fun though
